title: California's 48th Congressional District General Election, 2026
description: California's 48th Congressional District is an open seat after Republican incumbent Darrell Issa retired rather than seek reelection in a district redrawn by Proposition 50. The June 2 top-two primary sent Republican San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond and Democratic San Diego City Councilmember Marni von Wilpert to the general election. The new district has slightly more registered Democrats than Republicans, making it a key Democratic pickup target in the fight for control of the U.S. House. Desmond, who was endorsed by President Donald Trump, emphasizes border security, affordability, and local government experience, while von Wilpert, endorsed by EMILYs List and the DCCC's Red to Blue program, focuses on abortion rights, lowering costs, and opposing Trump's agenda.
polling_note: No general election head-to-head polls have been publicly released for the CA-48 general election as of mid-June 2026. Primary-era polling (SurveyUSA in April 2026) measured the crowded primary field but did not test a Desmond-von Wilpert matchup. Cook Political Report rates the race as Toss Up / Lean Democratic.

candidates.name: Jim Desmond
candidates.summary: Jim Desmond is a San Diego County Supervisor, former Mayor of San Marcos, retired Delta Air Lines captain, and U.S. Navy veteran who is running for Congress in the 48th District. He emphasizes his local government leadership, border security advocacy, and focus on lowering costs and homelessness. Desmond was endorsed by retiring incumbent Darrell Issa and by President Donald Trump.

career_history.title: San Diego County Supervisor, District 5
career_history.organization: San Diego County Board of Supervisors
career_history.description: Elected in 2018, reelected in 2022. Served as Vice Chair from 2020-2021. Focused on homelessness, border security, and county services.

career_history.title: Mayor
career_history.description: Served as mayor for 12 years after serving on the city council from 2004.

career_history.title: Airline Captain
career_history.description: Retired after 33 years as a pilot, flying Boeing 757 and 767 aircraft.

candidates.name: Marni von Wilpert
candidates.summary: Marni von Wilpert is a San Diego City Councilmember representing District 5, an attorney, and former prosecutor who is running for Congress in the 48th District. She previously worked as a workers' rights attorney, clerked for a federal judge, served in the Peace Corps in Botswana, and was Deputy City Attorney for San Diego. Her campaign emphasizes protecting abortion rights, lowering costs, opposing President Trump's agenda, and cleaning up corruption.
